cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pack your paintings for the last gallery. Keep that brush wet; you're finally painting again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you folded the big gallery's letter at 'unfortunately'? If that's another no, I'm done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll deal with that letter. This gallery still needs three; pick the ones you'd hang.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You choose. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll do the choosing and the post. Finish the blue one for me.

reason: Make concealment demonstrable through B noticing folded rejection wording; A adapts the submission workload instead of merely announcing authority, keeping B painting under the remaining hope.
